evidence.label: 明确提出新的评测资料或框架
evidence.excerpt: We introduce OS-Bench, an executable benchmark for cross-OS code migration between Linux and Windows.

evidence.label: 描述任务、问题或评测环境
evidence.excerpt: Language-model (LM) agents are increasingly evaluated on repository-level software engineering (SWE) benchmarks derived from GitHub issues and pull requests.

evidence.label: 报告基线或多个模型的评测
evidence.excerpt: Motivated by case studies showing that cross-platform features are frequently implemented on one OS before support is added for another, OS-Bench identifies migration opportunities by comparing execution coverage collected from the same repository on both systems.

evidence.label: 给出任务规模或覆盖范围
evidence.excerpt: The resulting benchmark contains 140 validated tasks from 111 repositories across C, C++, C#, Go, and Rust, comprising 91 Windows-to-Linux and 49 Linux-to-Windows migrations.
